links.outcome: Whether reasoning benchmark gains transfer to SOAP note generation quality across three datasets
links.effect: Enabling reasoning significantly degraded GPT-5.4 performance across all three datasets; non-reasoning GPT-5.4 scored highest overall, so benchmark reasoning strength did not predict task quality.
links.quote: Overall, the findings indicate that stronger reasoning capability should not be assumed to improve fidelity-sensitive SOAP note generation without dedicated, task-specific evaluation.
